site.title: viLilt — Pure On-Device Voice & Conversational Companion AI
site.description: Talk. Listen. Nothing else. 100% on-device neural voice and text AI companion for iOS & iPadOS.

hero.desc_bold: Zero cloud latency. Zero tool overhead.
hero.desc: viLilt is a pure, private on-device conversational AI companion. Featuring continuous hands-free voice dialogue, lifelike neural speech, 11 native languages, and customizable personas without cloud latency or subscription paywalls.

orb_preview.user_speaking: “Hey viLilt, can you help me practice expressing my design ideas with more clarity and confidence?”
orb_preview.assistant_reply: “I'd love that! Start by painting the overarching vision first — tell me what feeling you want someone to have when they first open your creation. Let's walk through it together.”

features.title: Designed for Pure Conversation
features.subtitle: Everything you need to talk, listen, and think freely — with none of the clutter.

privacy_page.title: viLilt Privacy Policy
privacy_page.s1_title: 1. Core Principle: Zero Data Leaves Your Device
privacy_page.s1_desc: viLilt is jointly developed by viaiforgood.org (Nonprofit) and VI AI INC. We believe voice conversation is an intrinsically private human experience. viLilt is engineered from ground zero to execute 100% on-device.
privacy_page.s2_desc: Your microphone audio stream is processed directly by Apple iOS on-device Speech APIs and local GGUF models on Apple Silicon. Audio recordings are never uploaded to cloud servers or used for third-party model training.
privacy_page.s3_desc: viLilt contains no third-party advertising SDKs, tracking frameworks, user profiling telemetry, or surveillance analytics.
privacy_page.s4_desc: If you have any questions regarding privacy or local security architecture, contact us at: developer@viai.ai or developer@viaiforgood.org.

footer.rights: All rights reserved. Dedicated to public good & privacy-preserving AI.
